prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Design Your Official Adoption Certificate", "Customize your pet's name and confirm your official adoption certificate.", "Finalize Adoption", "Official Adoption Seal", "Desktop Pet Name"]
1: ["Preparing Desktop Environment", "Checking system tray access and screen overlay compatibility for your pet.", "Continue to Spawning", "Your pet will appear near your system tray once ready."]
2: ["Save Your Custom Pet to Account", "Sign in now to permanently link your adoption certificate and pet progress.", "Save & Continue"]
3: ["Master Desktop Pet Controls", "Try clicking the controls below to see how to hide, summon, and interact with your pet.", "Start Playing", "Test Tray Hide & Show"]
4: ["Signing in restores previously created pets automatically without overwriting existing data."]
5: ["Spawning Your Pet to Desktop", "We are generating your pet graphics. You will receive a notification when it lands on your desktop."]
6: ["Bonus Desktop Trait Unlocked"]
7: ["Select Your Desktop Pet Journey", "Choose whether to pick a pre-made companion or design a custom pet from photos."]
8: ["Enable desktop alerts to know immediately when your pet spawns near your system tray."]
9: ["Your Interactive Desktop Companion Awaits", "Bring your desktop to life in under 2 minutes. Pick or create a pet that stays on your screen.", "Start Setup Now"]
